checklist.detail: The installed default resolved to /home/pippenz/.opencode/bin/opencode, reported 1.18.23, and had SHA-256 de0724a36eaf3166e7f1ff38d0f4478b95ccc47725e9597b3fe66d3d3e18baa2.

The real TUI submitted its initial --prompt and a 1,532-byte raw follow-up. Ctrl+C aborted an in-flight bash tool without killing the TUI; the same ses_* session accepted a bounded follow-up and returned ACTIVE_CANCEL_READY. Esc did not cancel and corrupted the next input byte, so it is not advertised.
The live process used --auto while its primary-agent policy retained external_directory=deny; an outside-repository read was denied rather than auto-approved.

Tool execution, exported message paths, plugin directory, git commit, and CAS identity resolved to the absolute disposable repository; inherited CAS session and agent metadata registered the expected workers.
The cassy-worker primary agent was selected and low/medium/xhigh runs returned the unique AGENTS.md sentinel AGENTS_VISIBLE_7A91.

OpenCode discovered cas_coordination, cas_task, and cas_verification. The medium run completed whoami, create/mine/show/start/notes, write, commit 5540ebb28190feb537c21bb5d441856b807140ec, push, resume, and verified close for cas-553d.

The Token Plan route authenticated and answered through OpenCode with qwencloud/qwen3.8-max; exported metadata independently recorded exact low, medium, and xhigh variants, with no remapping or secret in evidence.

The fixed async plugin factory persisted the CAS-to-ses_* mapping, awaited tool attribution, busy/idle state, and completion. Bounded export returned the mapped transcript; reverse tests cover error/deleted/process-dead and wedge classifications.
Two four-XDG roots produced disjoint databases, logs, model caches, and session lists. Neither root persisted the environment key in auth.json.
Not claimed: supports_subagents remains false, so this conditional cell is non-gating.
Four-harness launch/prefix parity and builtin flavor-drift targets pass after the measured capability update.

evidence.summary: Secret-free executable path, version, and SHA-256 pin from the installed binary used for the live runs.
Serial Token Plan sessions whose exported message metadata records exact low, medium, and xhigh variants.
Disposable CAS MCP task lifecycle, git commit/push, same-session resume, and verified close through OpenCode.
Raw terminal record and exported session proving initial prompt and 1,532-byte unframed follow-up submission.
The exported tool result records Ctrl+C as a user-aborted command; the retained ses_* session then returned ACTIVE_CANCEL_READY to a bounded follow-up.
OpenCode --auto run with explicit external_directory deny retained; the outside-repository read was denied.
Corrected plugin factory persisted ses_* mapping, awaited bash attribution, and idle state.
Mapped export records qwencloud/qwen3.8-max, xhigh, cassy-worker, cwd, tool completion, and response.
Disjoint session inventories from two separately rooted XDG layouts.
One completion-only Token Plan auth/answerability probe recording the sk-sp- credential prefix class, route, and serving identity but no key value.
Reverse-state tests cover busy-to-idle, error/deleted, process fallback/death, and wedge integration.
Four-harness selector, launch, prefix, injection, and measured capability contracts.
Claude, Codex, Grok, and OpenCode builtin projections remain synchronized.
